subject: general
question: Which color of the white light suffers maximum bending when it passes through a glass prism?
solution: The correct answer is __**Violet**__. • **Dispersion of white light **is defined as the** phenomenon of splitting white light** into **seven constituent colours** when passed through the prism. [IMAGE: https://qph.fs.quoracdn.net/main-qimg-1433d0694ab48314fc31aaa145b4cbdd]
